subject.title: chore(queue): add exact merge preflight jobs

question: Should this PR add merge-only autonomous jobs for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98505 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89997 with the current exact-head preflight gates?
rationale: These files can drive later guarded external merges, and one target currently has live merge-risk labels, so only maintainer intent can decide whether to queue them now or wait.

options.title: Land with target-risk acknowledgement
options.body: Merge this PR if maintainers want the jobs queued now and accept that the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98505 job should block until its target merge-risk labels are cleared.

options.title: Hold until target labels are clear
options.body: Delay this PR until both external targets are label-clean and ready for exact-head preflight execution.

recommendation.title: Land with target-risk acknowledgement
recommendation.body: Merge this PR if maintainers want the jobs queued now and accept that the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98505 job should block until its target merge-risk labels are cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the exact-merge/preflight guardrails and this queue PR, so he is the best available owner for the operational merge decision.
